mechanism_narrative: Higher current federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) levels compress equity valuations by increasing the discount rate for future cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 209.0 signals persistent inflation, prompting central bank tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 209.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 4.5% and CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 208.5, it signals a persistent inflationary environment requiring aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both conditions hold, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 4.8%, it signals a tight labor market driving wage inflation and central bank tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 4.8, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1350, it signals a strengthening housing market and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in less than 40% of instances where HOUST > 1350, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 110.0 signals an immediate manufacturing slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO < 110.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (defined as FEDFUNDS increasing by more than 0.5% over the last 3 months), the S&P 500 tends to have negative returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in higher interest rates.
failure_condition: Rank IC between the monetary tightening cycle signal and 60-day returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in retail sales (RSAFS) above 375000 signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in less than 40% of instances where RSAFS > 375000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
